name: Websol Energy
why: Management outlook: We expect the upgrade to be completed by March 2027.
Promoters raised their stake by 2.0 pts in a year
Sector cycle: Earnings improving but price not confirming
risks: Not at record: quarterly sales, quarterly profit
Margins shrinking (47% to 34%) - record profit may be near peak
Working capital stretching - debtor days 3 to 35, inventory days 70 to 142 (rising): check receivables / stock build-up
Credit rating BBB+/Stable (CRISIL) - weaker credit quality
Latest quarter Jun 2026: Weak (sales +70% YoY, profit +16% YoY)
FIIs (foreign funds) cut holding by 1.3 pts in a year
Shareholder count up 36% in a year - retail crowding in
Cost quality weak: margin shrinking or operating profit falling (costs 53% to 66% of sales)

order_book: On the order book, we closed the quarter with a confirmed order book of INR1,278 crores as on 30th June 2026, against INR1,161 crores at the end of March 2026.
Right now, I guess we have close to INR1,200 crores of order book.
guidance: We expect the upgrade to be completed by March 2027.
On input costs, we brought silver consumption down by 20% during financial year ‘26 and have set our cells a further 10% reduction target.
capex: Websol Energy System Limited August 11, 2026 Page 3 of 19 We doubled our cell capacity largely through internally generated funds, and we have now repaid this term loan from cash generated by the business as well.
On completion, that line will have 750 megawatt of TOPCon capacity, taking Websol's overall cell manufacturing capacity to 1.3 gigawatt, with approximately 55% of our cell capacity on TOPCon.
risks: We are hopeful that any interim delay arising from the change in this location will be substantially offset by these operating synergies.
We are not expecting any delays at this stage and our plans have not changed.
focus: There is considerable opportunity in Indian solar manufacturing, and we believe, West Bengal in particular is entering an interesting phase.

Recent direction of the state towards greater industrialization, including the proposed new industrial policy, simpler access to industrial land and a stronger focus on attracting manufacturing investment is encouraging
We enter the rest of the year with our existing capacity running much closer to its potential and with the TOPCon upgrade underway.
